name: mobile
summary: Patch 1.9.1: references/expo.md was authored as a delta on references/react-native.md, but the install path does not guarantee the base file — phase-4.2-apply.md copies only the detected frameworks, and nothing pairs expo with react-native — so an Expo-only detection installed a file whose first instruction pointed at an absent one. 1.9.0 raised the cost of that gap by moving the render fingerprints into references/<framework>.md; expo.md was the one reference of five with no such section, leaving an Expo project without the base layer AND without the fingerprint layer render-discipline.md sends it to read. expo.md now carries § Render-discipline fingerprints — routing all 8 detectors to the React Native column rather than duplicating a table that would drift, plus the two deltas that are genuinely Expo's (detectors 1 and 8 land in the app/ router tree, and closing 5 and 6 requires `npx expo install`, never `npm install`) — and its header now states the base-layer dependency as an install instruction instead of an assumption. All five references now carry the section _essentials.md promises. The pre-1.7.0 layer, graded for the first time. /add-screen became a scope-narrowing overlay on /add-feature (it was a weaker copy whose Heavy tier, defined by 'biometric / Keychain / secrets touch', dispatched no security review, no store review and no durability audit, and whose Phase 3 read three files that do not exist). Both 1.8.0 auditors are now dispatched by add-feature's Phase 4 preconditions. Six fabrications removed and replaced with what determines the answer: a bridge-bug percentage, an AsyncStorage speed multiple, a FlashList item threshold, a WebP saving range, three uncited platform maxima, and a React Native 'built-in Updates' API that has never existed. Dead tooling retired: hosted CodePush (App Center retired 2025-03-31), Flipper, react-native-background-task, react-native-fast-image, peek-and-pop, Settings.System.ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE, SafeAreaView-from-core, Android Slices. New depth where the pack had none: biometric-gated secrets, the Android 13 POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission, and Play's 16 KB page-size gate. Always-loaded rule cost 4,558 -> ~3,530 tokens by moving the per-framework fingerprints into references/.
